about: The live bad_deploy break of 2026-11-13: break at 02:57:16, errors into ALARM at 02:57:45, cleared by hand at 02:58:33, OK at 02:59:15. The runtime's run, signed in by federation with no key path left, diagnosed it. 2026-11-12's three breaks are in the deploy history, the last 7 hours earlier. No other alarm fired.
account: 123456789012 stands in for the account ID wherever AWS wrote it.
